Rebuild this shot clean, in one pass, from Image 1.

FILM STILL: vertical 9:16 live-action frame, inside the last carriage of a night train, looking at the small window of its door; Diego is outside it, in the gangway.
MOMENT: Diego's LEFT palm has just hit the glass and stays flat, five separate fingers spread. His head is turned back over his RIGHT shoulder, toward frame left, in profile; his eyes are on the far end of the gangway behind him, where dark shapes have come closer.
COMPOSITION: seen from inside. The rounded window with rhombic wire mesh fills most of the frame, set right of centre; grey-green riveted door metal down the left edge. Diego is chest to the glass, framed from the ribs up, head in the upper left third. His LEFT palm is on the glass in the lower right third, its cuff clean. His RIGHT sleeve, at frame left, forearm across his chest, is the only marked part of the jacket: torn, with dark red-black stains from elbow to cuff; no wound. Both shoulders and the chest are clean wet canvas. The glass is dry, with a few dark matte smears left earlier. Behind him only the dark gangway: black ribbed bellows walls in a faint dark red cast and, already halfway up it, two or three blurred dark human shadows, faces unreadable. The gangway holds no seats and no doorway.
Diego: straight black hair, wet and stuck to his forehead; three-day beard; pale stone canvas jacket, soaked and darker at the shoulders; dark grey hood underneath.
LENS: 50mm at T2.8, handheld at standing eye height. Focus on the palm; the shadows stay soft.
LIGHT: one cold tube above the glass is the only light. It is on our side, just out of frame, and falls steep through the glass on his hand and cheekbone; the far side of the face stays in shadow. No lamp behind him.
TEXTURE: Clean photographic image, no film grain, no digital sharpening, no HDR look, no glow halos, no orange-teal rim light, real skin texture with pores.
FINISH: Nobody looks into the lens; every gaze has a target inside the carriage. No text, no captions, no watermark, no logos.
